title: Weird Egg
body: A gift from the Cucco-keeping woman in Kakariko Village. Carry it around until it hatches into a Pocket Cucco overnight.

title: Pocket Cucco
body: Use it to wake sleepy Talon (at Lon Lon Ranch or in Kakariko), then bring it back to the Cucco lady.

title: Cojiro
body: The rare blue Cucco you get in return. It never spoils, so take your time on this step.

title: Odd Mushroom
body: Trade Cojiro for it with the poacher hiding in the Lost Woods.

title: Odd Potion
body: Rush it to the old woman at the potion shop within 3 minutes — the mushroom spoils fast.

title: Poacher's Saw
body: Hand it to the young Kokiri woman lost in the Lost Woods maze.

title: Broken Goron's Sword
body: The Master Carpenter in Gerudo Valley fixes his mold in exchange for the saw and hands you the broken sword next.

title: Prescription
body: Climb Death Mountain and give the broken sword to Biggoron; he asks for a prescription in return.

title: Eyeball Frog
body: Deliver the prescription to King Zora (already freed from the ice); he passes it to the doctor frogs and brings back an eyeball frog.

title: Eyedrops
body: Rush the frog to the Lake Hylia lab within 3 minutes for the 'world's finest eye drops.'

title: Claim Check
body: Bring the eyedrops to Biggoron within 4 minutes; he takes 3 in-game days to reforge the sword and hands you a claim check.

title: Biggoron's Sword
body: Return after those 3 days with the claim check — Biggoron hands over the strongest weapon in the game.

name: Bottle with a Cucco
how: Round up every loose Cucco in Anju's pen before time runs out

name: Bigger Quiver
how: Clear a set score threshold in Gerudo's Fortress's Horseback Archery

name: Rupees from Big Poes
how: Catch Big Poes on horseback with the Bow and sell them at the Market's Ghost Shop at night

name: Light Arrows
how: Clear the Gerudo Training Ground room by room to earn them

name: Double Magic
how: Play the Song of Storms in front of a hidden Great Fairy near Ganon's Castle

name: Double Defense
how: Play the Song of Storms in front of another hidden Great Fairy around Hyrule Castle

name: Mask of Truth
how: Return every mask borrowed from the Happy Mask Shop on time — unlocks extra dialogue with certain characters
